purpose: package a finished change so a reviewer can understand it, verify it and merge it safely
entry_criteria: The change builds and its tests pass locally
A work item with acceptance criteria exists
The branch is current with the target branch
inputs: linked work item and acceptance criteria
procedure: Keep the change to one purpose; split unrelated work into separate pull requests.
Write a title and description that state what changed, why, how it was tested and what could go wrong.
Link the work item and note any migration, configuration or rollout step the reviewer must know about.
Run the project's checks locally and confirm the CI checks start and pass.
Self-review the diff first and remove debug code, stray files and secrets.
Request reviewers who own the affected area and respond to comments promptly.
acceptance_criteria: Description states purpose, testing and risk
The diff contains only the intended change
CI checks are running or green
validation_method: Code review (stage 69) and merge approval (stage 75) follow.

validation.expect: changed files match the stated purpose
required checks are pending or passing

failure_modes.response: Remove, rotate if a secret, and force a clean history before review
Write the description before requesting review

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A pull request adds an export endpoint. The description lists the new route, the test that covers pagination, and a note that a new index is created by migration 0042.
